Announce his salvation from day to day.

For the Lord is great and greatly to be praised.
For all the gods of the Gentiles are demons,
but the Lord made the heavens.

Confession and beauty are in his sight.

adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus.
Adore the Lord in his holy court.

Let the entire earth be shaken before his face.

He will judge the peoples with fairness.
